product_line: Hammond Power Solutions (HPS) Sentinel G energy-efficient general-purpose low-voltage distribution transformers (600 V class)
purpose: Second-vendor record to prove the transformer facts model generalises beyond Eaton. Deliberately thin: two model points read from a distributor listing plus the manufacturer's published range statement.
license_note: Rating / dimensional FACTS only. No HPS drawings, CAD/BIM files, catalog prose or images stored. See ../LICENSE_NOTES.md.

Facts came from an authorized distributor product listing (one page read) and a search-engine summary of the manufacturer's product page. Every field carries its verification level.
